findings.description: Critical Drug-Drug Interaction: Warfarin co-prescribed with TMP-SMX (Trimethoprim-Sulfamethoxazole), causing significant CYP2C9 inhibition and bleeding risk.
Omission of mandatory anticoagulant surveillance schedule or INR follow-up interval in discharge instructions.

explainedTerms.definition: Metabolic blockage of cytochrome P450 2C9 by TMP-SMX, leading to elevated free warfarin levels and hemorrhage danger.
Laboratory measurement of blood clotting time used to guide safe oral anticoagulation.
